sources.groundStands: Three mapped taxiway centerlines reclassified as apron 4 stands 21–23. Their order and endpoint orientation were compared with the 2020 Afghan AIP parking diagram; stop points remain mapped endpoints, not surveyed coordinates. This static snapshot does not incorporate time-limited NOTAM closures.

stand20Repair.note: The final straight branch of the mapped apron line matches stand 20 in the 2020 apron 4 diagram. The original line is split at the common junction and all coordinates are retained; the endpoint is mapped rather than a surveyed checkpoint.
